BEHIND THE SCENES

A C++ project, in your browser.

Frame is a movie rating system built around a shared C++ core. Your catalog, validation, recommendations, searching, sorting, and statistics run as compiled WebAssembly.

C++17 → WebAssemblyMovie objects · Catalog methods · CalculationsHTML + CSS + JavaScriptInterface · Event handling · Browser storage

Ratings of 7.0 or higher are recommended. Watchlist movies are unrated and excluded from averages. Each movie has a title, genre, release year, rating, and optional review.

Your data stays in this browser. Export a JSON backup before switching devices or clearing browser data. Imports replace the current catalog only after every record is validated. Up to 500 movies are supported.

The submission kit includes a console interface using cin and cout, the shared C++ source, a project report, and a three-minute video script.
